theorems.name: Submission.w12_ball_translation_estimate
theorems.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ (f : Rn n → ℝ) (g : Rn n → Rn n), IsW12WithGradient f g (ball 0 1) → ∀ (r : ℝ) (z : Rn n), 0 < r → ‖z‖ < 1 - r → ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ‖f (x - z) - f x‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (‖z‖ ^ 2) * ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖g x‖ₑ ^ 2
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
